title: The Devil's Star
subtitle: Jo Nesbø, 2003 · Harry Hole #5
blurb: Oslo detective Harry Hole, battling alcoholism and professional disgrace, is assigned to investigate a series of murders in which the victims—young women—each have a finger severed and a tiny red diamond in the shape of a five-pointed star left beneath an eyelid. The case forces Harry into an uneasy partnership with his nemesis, Tom Waaler, while a parallel investigation into police corruption converges with the killings.

factions.label: Oslo Police / Crime Squad
factions.description: Detectives and officers of Oslo's Kripos and Crime Squad investigating the diamond murders and internal corruption.

factions.label: Victims & Families
factions.description: The murder victims and their close relatives drawn into the investigation.

factions.label: The Corrupt Network
factions.description: Officers and associates involved in the criminal conspiracy operating within the police force.

factions.label: Civilian Associates
factions.description: Journalists, medical professionals, and private citizens who intersect with the investigation.

characters.name: Harry Hole
characters.description: A brilliant but self-destructive detective whose alcoholism has pushed him to the margins of the force. Reluctantly assigned to the diamond murders, he uncovers a conspiracy reaching deep into the Oslo Police.

characters.name: Tom Waaler
characters.description: Harry's charming, ambitious, and dangerous partner on the case. Secretly the mastermind of the criminal network within the police and ultimately revealed as the serial killer responsible for the diamond murders.

characters.name: Beate Lønn
characters.role: Crime Scene Technician / Facial Recognition Expert
characters.description: A shy, gifted forensic technician with a rare ability to memorise faces. She becomes a vital ally to Harry and helps break open the case.

characters.name: Bjarne Møller
characters.description: Harry's direct superior and one of his few genuine supporters within the department. Tries to manage the fallout from Harry's erratic behaviour while keeping him operational.

characters.name: Ellen Gjelten
characters.description: Harry's murdered former partner, killed in a previous novel. Her unsolved death—connected to Waaler's network—haunts Harry throughout this case and drives his determination to expose the corruption.

characters.name: Rakel Fauke
characters.description: A lawyer with whom Harry has a complicated romantic relationship. Her presence represents the personal stakes Harry risks through his drinking and dangerous work.

characters.name: Oleg Fauke
characters.description: Rakel's young son, to whom Harry has formed a paternal attachment. His wellbeing is a key emotional motivation for Harry.

characters.name: Camilla Loen
characters.description: One of the young women murdered by the serial killer; her death, with a severed finger and a red diamond star beneath her eyelid, is a central case in the investigation.

characters.name: Lisbeth Barli
characters.description: Another victim in the series; her death helps Harry establish the killer's pattern and connection to the pentagram motif.

characters.name: Barbara Svendsen
characters.description: An early victim whose death sets the serial murder investigation in motion.

characters.name: Anne Størksen
characters.description: A later victim in the sequence; the escalating killings around her case push Harry toward the final confrontation.

characters.name: Ivarsson
characters.description: A senior officer placed in charge of the diamond murder case, sidelining Harry. His bureaucratic rivalry with Harry creates friction that hampers the investigation.

characters.name: Magnus Skarre
characters.description: A junior detective on the investigative team who serves as a procedural presence in several inquiry scenes.

characters.name: Sigurd Altman
characters.description: A figure connected to Waaler's criminal network who comes under scrutiny during the investigation, illustrating the breadth of corruption within the force.

characters.name: Gunnar Hagen
characters.description: A police administrator whose position intersects with both the murder inquiry and the internal affairs questions raised by the corruption investigation.

coverage_note: Minor named victims and peripheral officers are omitted due to the 25-character cap. The network of Waaler's criminal associates is summarised through Sigurd Altman rather than enumerated individually. Some character name details (e.g. the Altman and Hagen roles) reflect best-effort reconstruction from the novel's dense ensemble and may contain minor name inaccuracies at the minor-character tier.
notes: The Devil's Star is the fifth Harry Hole novel. The reveal of Tom Waaler as both the serial killer and Ellen Gjelten's murderer resolves a thread running since The Redbreast (#4). This map contains full spoilers including the climactic confrontation in which Harry kills Waaler.
